We are a diverse, mission-driven team that is eager to work alongside kindred spirits. If this vision makes you smile, gives you goosebumps, or otherwise inspires you please get in touch. jobs.title: Trading Systems Configuration Engineer / Product Specialist, Middle & Back Office
jobs.description_text: Belvedere Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm proudly headquartered in downtown Chicago. Our traders work hard to provide liquidity to the market through their market-making activities and are the masters of a diverse set of commodities, interest rates, exchange-traded funds (ETF), and equity index options. From the beginning, we began iteratively investing in our proprietary technology and committing to building our systems from the ground up. Our trading models and software systems are continually re-engineered, optimized, and maintained to stay on top of the industry. This wouldn’t be possible without the dedicated efforts of our technology teams who utilize and perfect our innovative technology solutions. We're hiring an engineer who sits between trading, technology and operations. You'll configure new products and trading desks across our in-house trading platform, automate that work so it's faster and safer, and own advanced support for our middle and back office systems. When we launch a new product, you make sure every system (pricing, risk, order routing, positions, and PnL) knows about it on day one. When something breaks downstream, you're the person who can trace it back to the source. Additionally, certain positions at Belvedere Trading are eligible for discretionary bonuses. jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads is building the largest mobility media network. Brands use Lyft Ads to reach riders throughout their journeys, in the Lyft app, in the real world, and across the open web. Every time a rider opens the app, our systems decide in milliseconds which message they see, whether it’s a paid ad, an incentive, or a product message from another Lyft team.

The Ad Decisioning team owns that choice. We run the serving, pacing, and auction systems behind every ad on Lyft surfaces, and we are building a first-party decisioning platform that lets paid and unpaid messages compete in a single auction based on their value to riders, advertisers, and Lyft. This platform is shared infrastructure. Ads and other teams will all use it to reach riders and drivers across multiple apps and surfaces. The work spans real-time distributed systems, auction design, and close partnership with teams across Lyft that message riders and drivers.

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead this team. Lyft Urban Solutions powers the bike-share and scooter-share systems that move millions of people in more than 60 cities worldwide. The Marketplace organization at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Pricing sits at the heart of it. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description_text:
Senior Data Scientist, Decisions – Autonomous Vehicles

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The future of Lyft is a hybrid network, where autonomous vehicles and human drivers serve riders side by side on one platform. That future has already started. In September 2026, Lyft riders in Nashville were matched with Waymo autonomous vehicles on the Lyft app for the first time. Our partnerships now span Waymo in Nashville, May Mobility in Atlanta and Baidu in Europe, with more on the way.

The Global Growth organization is charting the future of Lyft’s growth beyond North American rideshare’s core products, including bringing Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) to riders domestically and abroad. As a Senior Data Scientist, Decisions for AV, you will be the science partner for the AV product team. You’ll use experimentation and data to decide what we build, how we launch it, and how we know it’s working. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, operations and partnership leaders, and present your recommendations to senior leadership and AV partners.

In this role, you will help us answer questions such as:

  • Rider adoption and trust: What makes a rider choose, accept or opt out of an autonomous ride, and which product changes increase adoption?

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Mapping
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

For us, maps aren't just background graphics—they’re the core of the driver’s experience. While generic navigation apps focus on the everyday commute, Lyft Mapping is custom-built for the high-stakes, split-second realities of the rideshare experience. Drivers choose Lyft Maps because we solve the unique, complex challenges of living on the road: delivering glanceable turn guidance at speed, navigating tricky pick-up & drop-off dynamics, and providing real-time, AI-powered route assistance when every second counts. We build technology that empowers our drivers, transforms uncertainty into seamless flow, and sets the standard for real-time mobile navigation.

We obsess over questions like: did your pickup spot feel safe and convenient? Did your driver feel confident following the route and arriving on the correct side of the road? Did you get stuck in unexpected traffic or road closures? You will tackle all of these challenges and more, with end to end ownership over the full ride experience, including driver navigation and rider pickup experiences.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
jobs.description_text: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. What You'll Work On Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.
